featured_reviews.name: Rushikesh Bhusari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Misleading Photos, Hygiene Issues, and Unfair Refund Practices

I booked a room with GetSetHome at Premier Exotica 1, Kurla West after looking at the polished photos on their website. But when I actually moved in, the reality was completely different — the property had serious hygiene issues, including cockroaches in the kitchen and washroom, and a general lack of cleanliness. Despite repeated complaints, the caretaker was unresponsive and nothing improved.

What shocked me more was that my roommate was paying a different rent for the exact same room type — completely unprofessional and unfair.

When I vacated the property early (within the conditions mentioned in their contract), I expected a refund after the standard deductions. Instead, they falsely claimed I had a balance due and completely denied any refund — even though I had followed all terms. To make it worse, they refused to share the rental agreement when I asked for documentation, raising serious trust issues.

This platform is misleading, non-transparent, and unaccountable. I strongly advise others to not book just by looking at pictures — visit the place first if you must, but I personally would not recommend GetSetHome at all.

**Update (After One Year):**

To make matters worse, this issue did not end when I vacated the property. Before leaving, I had informed them about my move-out and called multiple times, but received no response from their side.

Nearly a year later, GetSetHome withheld my deposit, claimed additional rent dues, imposed penalties, and even sent me a legal notice. They also contacted my workplace regarding the matter, which I found completely unnecessary and highly unprofessional.

In the end, I lost more than ₹30,000 through withheld deposits, rent claims, and various charges for what was essentially an 8-10 day period. What should have been a straightforward move-out process turned into a long, stressful, and frustrating ordeal.

Another issue I repeatedly noticed was the lack of transparency around maintenance and service charges. In my experience, even for relatively minor repairs or services, the amounts charged often seemed excessively high, and supporting bills or invoices were not always provided when requested. This made it difficult to understand or verify the actual cost of the work being done.

After dealing with misleading property photos, hygiene issues, poor support, refund disputes, withheld deposits, unexplained charges, and legal threats, I can confidently say that my experience with GetSetHome has been one of the worst rental experiences I have had. I would strongly advise anyone looking for accommodation to stay away from GetSetHome and consider more transparent and tenant-friendly alternatives.

featured_reviews.name: Akanksha_ Pawar

featured_reviews.name: Rafiya farheen
featured_reviews.review_text:
I took this PG for one month, but unfortunately I had to leave within just 3 days due to serious issues.
Firstly, the PG is not organized or properly managed by the owner, Mansi. There is no hygiene maintained. The washroom and washbasin are extremely dirty and unclean. The kitchen is not properly accessible — only a few people are allowed to use it, while others are restricted. You cannot cook properly.
This is the month of Ramzan, and when I raised concerns regarding basic facilities, my complaints were ignored. The warden clearly refused washing clothes saying, “If I get time, I will do,” which is very unprofessional. There is also theft happening — many residents’ belongings are going missing.
Most importantly, there is no proper space or freedom to offer namaz peacefully. When I complained about these issues, the warden behaved rudely and misbehaved. After the owner Mansi leaves, arguments continue till 2 AM, disturbing everyone and that cause me a mental Harrasement.
The warden is a 19-year-old girl from Nepal who does not understand our language properly and is not capable of managing the PG responsibly.
There is a prepaid system — if you pay for one full month, there is strictly no refund under any circumstances. Even though the facilities and commitments promised on the first day were not fulfilled, they refused to consider any refund.
Because of all this, I lost my full amount of ₹6,000 within just 3 days.
Overall, it was a very stressful and disappointing experience. Basic hygiene, proper management, safety, and respect for residents are completely lacking.

featured_reviews.name: Era Singal
featured_reviews.review_text: I stayed in this PG for two months. Warden's behaviour is mysterious and she treat everyone unfairly except a women Rehana. I was having fever and told them to reduce the coldness of AC but they denied.

featured_reviews.name: SimpleVibes
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Kurla PG offers good facilities and overall management, but there is a serious issue with the warden’s behavior. She shows clear favoritism towards a few girls (such as Rehna and Mohana) by doing their personal work and letting them control the lights, while treating others unfairly.
Additionally, late-night disturbances are common, with some residents talking on calls till 3 AM, making it difficult to study or sleep peacefully.
Management action is needed to ensure fair treatment and a peaceful living environment for all residents.
